name: Lakeville Monday Scramble
oneLiner: Two-person scramble against the field, handicapped, over 18 holes — twelve weeks of regular season and two of playoffs. League Member Extra’s: (2) Hours of anytime sim time to use outside of league!
beginnerNote: A scramble is the friendliest format there is: you both hit, you take the better ball and go again from there. Handicaps level the field, so nobody has to card a bad hole on their own.
format: 2-person scramble against the field, handicapped, 18 holes. Format may change based on player feedback.
price: $980 per team. A $50 non-refundable deposit per team holds your spot.
prizes: Prizes dependent on size of League
